name: Dynamic Asteroids 2.0 (Cyclone)
author: keltuze
description: Standard Edition 2.0.5: Living asteroid belts (100–1000 rocks, 60s lifespan) with endless planetary ring avalanche, omnidirectional 360 cyclones & anticyclones, multi-angle converging swarms, and targeted sniper torrents (5 percent) against ships! Safe balanced collision velocity (600 u/s), sparkling kinetic trails, and live hotkeys [/] and [Shift +/-] in simulation.
